construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written for this build

shared_schema.input: Exact keys: schema_version (integer 1), dataset_label (nonblank string up to 200 trimmed characters), feedback (0..1000 objects with unique trimmed id 1..128 characters and text 1..10000 characters containing word characters). Unknown fields rejected.
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status=ok, dataset_label, summary (input_count, unique_count, duplicate_count), groups (group_id, canonical_id, normalized_text, sources), themes (theme_id, unique_feedback_count, source_count, group_ids, excerpts)
shared_schema.evidence: Each excerpt has group_id, source_id, start, end, text. Offsets are half-open Python character offsets into unchanged source text. All sources remain embedded in groups.
shared_schema.errors: Single JSON object with schema_version=1, status=error and error.type/error.message; exit 2 for usage, validation, JSON, decoding and file errors.
shared_schema.validation: One validate function enforces input structure and output evidence relationships/count consistency. Strict JSON parsing rejects duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers.

cross_stage_handoffs: One integrated stage: validated records -> normalized duplicate groups retaining all originals -> fixed lexical themes and source excerpts -> validated JSON result.

behavior.deduplication: NFKC Unicode normalization, casefolding and word-token joining; punctuation/whitespace differences ignored. First occurrence is canonical. Stable group IDs follow input order.
behavior.themes: Fixed whole-word keyword dictionaries for delivery, price, product_quality, support and usability; unmatched feedback is other. Multiple themes allowed; alphabetical theme ordering.
behavior.support: First matching original keyword with at most 40 characters of context on either side per source/theme; if Unicode normalization creates a keyword without a direct original token, the full bounded source is the excerpt. Other uses first 120 characters.
behavior.counting: Theme unique_feedback_count counts groups, source_count counts original feedback records. Theme totals may exceed overall totals because themes overlap.
behavior.synthetic_data: Example and all tests explicitly use synthetic data.
behavior.llm: None: all analysis deterministic and local.

test_outcomes.cli_status: passed: exit 0, one JSON object, status ok
